craft_notes: Sthāyin: canon. Sanskrit-first: double parameśinā kept. Rows: 2. Close: doubt. Rejected: dropping one source — killed: two attestations. Read aloud: binding cadence.

lines: Two books, one Lord, one bound doubt.
